scope: offline complete-design candidate only; no production application changes
simulation_boundary: Checks and sample translations are page-local simulations. No HTTP requests, downloads, system translation, filesystem inspection or DLL invocation.
purpose_boundary: translation only; grammar and contextual word explanation keep LLM configurations
export_boundary: Local portable declarations only. No local paths, Bottle, authorization, readiness, tests, pivot confirmation or enabled native bindings; import requires rebinding and fresh checks.
images: Existing assets/manifest.json identifies shared historical images; no approved image or token copied or refreshed.
approval: No new design approval or product/runtime acceptance is claimed.
scope_boundary: Enablement is keyed by scope and engine. A replaced primary must be applied again before enablement. Grammar / word explanations reject native translation even when a malformed reference is injected.
capability_gates: Apple OS/API/traditional strategy unknown, macOS 14, macOS 15, macOS 26, macOS26.4 unknown strategy, highFidelity exclusion, unknown/unsupported language pair; Argos unimplemented/pending route. Blocked branches cannot sample-test, apply as runnable, or enable. Success is an explicit page-external design condition.
health_boundary: Latest availability result is retained by engine and configuration/capability identity. A failure matching an applied snapshot blocks enablement and effective dispatch; failures for a different unapplied draft do not affect the older applied identity.
